scientific_integrity: The equivariant projection principle and single (n-2,2) block norm are acknowledged prior work. All-new statements concern the exact full-band sign, finite formula, normalized limit, and strict block comparison. Analytical proof and independent reproducible finite diagnostics included.
scientific_limitations: Complex two-subset Fourier bands on finite symmetric groups only; no classification of all minimizers. Priority risk: an equivalent character-algebra formula might predate this calculation. Finite enumeration cannot prove the all-n theorem.
title: Sharp projection constants of the two-subset Fourier band on symmetric groups
